card.name: Xòe Thái (Art of Xòe dance)
card.profile: Xòe (meaning "dance" in Thái) performed at rituals, weddings and festivals in three types — ritual, circle and presentational; circle xòe (vòng xòe), dancers joining hands in synchrony, is most popular. Accompanied by gourd lutes, drums, gongs, cymbals and reed flutes. UNESCO 2021 (Vietnam’s 14th ICH element).
